model: Disney Minnie Mouse Light Up 3-Wheel Scooter
description:
The Huffy Minnie Mouse Tilt 'N Turn Scooter brings Disney magic to every ride with colorful Minnie Mouse graphics and playful pink styling. Designed for kids ages 3 and up, this 3-wheel scooter inspires active outdoor play and imaginative adventures.
Tilt 'N Turn steering and a stable three-wheel design help young riders develop balance and coordination with every ride. A durable steel and frame, wide deck, and easy rear foot brake provide the support and control beginners need.
Front and rear LED light-up wheels add extra excitement as kids cruise the sidewalk. Built for everyday adventures, this Minnie Mouse scooter delivers fun, confidence, and Disney-inspired smiles wherever the ride leads.

components.description: Rear Foot Brake: Easy-to-use rear brake gives kids simple, reliable stopping power for confident riding.
